hooks.command: if [ -z "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT" ]; then echo "agent-review-inbox: CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT isn't set, so the hooks can't find review.py and the review inbox is off."; exit 0; fi; R="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/review-inbox/review.py"; P=; for c in python3 python "$HOME"/AppData/Local/Programs/Python/Python3*/python.exe /opt/homebrew/bin/python3 /usr/local/bin/python3; do "$c" -c "" 2>/dev/null && { P=$c; break; }; done; if [ -n "$P" ]; then "$P" "$R" hook; elif py -3 -c "" 2>/dev/null; then py -3 "$R" hook; else echo "agent-review-inbox: Python 3 isn't installed, so the review inbox is off. Offer to install it (Windows: \`winget install Python.Python.3.12\`, or without winget the installer from https://www.python.org/downloads/windows/ run with \`/quiet InstallAllUsers=0 PrependPath=1 Include_test=0 Include_doc=0 Include_tcltk=0\`; macOS: \`brew install python\`; Linux: \`sudo apt install python3\`), then open a new terminal and restart the session."; fi
